backlog.description: Socket connection backlog. Maximum number of queued connections.

hosts.description: List of host addresses to bind. If empty, defaults to '0.0.0.0' and '::'.

inbuf_overflow.description: Bytes threshold before spilling request body to temp file. Defaults to 524288 (512 KiB).

max_request_body_size.description: Maximum allowed request body size in bytes. Larger requests get HTTP 413. Defaults to 1 GiB.

port.description: Port to bind. Cannot be used with unix_socket.

script_name.description: URL prefix for the WSGI app. Must start with '/', no trailing '/' if non-empty.

shutdown_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for closing client connections on shutdown.

static_cors.description: CORS header value for static files. '*' for all origins, or a specific origin string. Empty means no CORS header.

static_routes.description: List of static route mappings (path → directory). Each entry must have 'path' (starts with '/', no trailing '/') and 'directory'.

threads.description: Number of threads for WSGI app processing.

unix_socket.description: Path to a Unix socket to bind. Mutually exclusive with host/port.

unix_socket_perms.description: Filesystem permissions (octal) for the Unix socket. Defaults to 384 (0o600).

url_scheme.description: URL scheme hint ('http' or 'https'). Empty means auto-detected.
